ce_bugs.text: app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:24 — Admin group create/update no longer accept the existing group-wrapped request payload, so external callers silently create blank/default groups or ignore updates.
app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — The public members endpoint accepts an unbounded `limit`, allowing a caller to materialize and serialize an entire large group in one request.

spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:115 — The automatic-group removal test invokes the action with PUT even though the new route only accepts DELETE, so it does not exercise the endpoint contract.

mrv_findings.text: [75][P1] app/assets/javascripts/discourse/templates/group/members.hbs:6 — `{{#each m in members}}` — setupController supplies the Group only as `model`, so the unqualified `members` property is absent and the public members table cannot render the fetched list.

[75][P1] app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:90 — `group.users.delete(user_id)` — the association deletion API takes user records or a relation, so this coerced integer can raise instead of removing the selected user.

[100][P1] app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:13 — `return Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1;` — exact multiples of the page size create an extra empty membership page.

[100][P1] app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` — public groups over 50 members are silently truncated because the changed members template has no pagination controls.
[75][P2] app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:28 — `render json: {` — the new public member-list response contract and pagination behavior have no request/controller coverage.

[100][P1] app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:28 — `render json: { members: serialize_data(members, GroupUserSerializer), meta: { ... } }` — changing the established public members endpoint from a bare array to an object envelope without versioning breaks callers that iterate the response as an array.

[100][P1] app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:38 — `group.name = (params[:name] || '').strip` — replacing the `group[name]` request contract with an unwrapped parameter makes existing admin clients submit no name and create an unintended blank or invalid group.

[100][P2] app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` — an unbounded client-controlled page size can materialize and serialize an entire large group, defeating the pagination bound.

[100][P2] app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:13 — `return Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1;` — exact multiples advertise an extra page, whose offset equals total and renders as a valid empty page.

[100][P2] app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71 — `usernames.split(",").each do |username|` — bulk membership adds make one `User.find_by_username` query per username rather than a set-based lookup.

[75][P2] app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:30 — `}).then(function(result) { self.setProperties({ ... members: result.members.map(...) }); });` — rapid next/previous requests can resolve out of order and overwrite the model with a stale page because no sequencing guard exists.

[75][P2] app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` — an authorized caller can supply an unbounded limit to force a huge membership serialization response and exhaust API resources.

[100][P1] app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:28 — `render json: { members: serialize_data(members, GroupUserSerializer), meta: { total: total, limit: limit, offset: offset } }` — no changed test exercises the public endpoint’s envelope/pagination contract, so a response shape or metadata regression can ship green.

[100][P1] app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js:30 — `}).then(function(result) { self.setProperties({ user_count: result.meta.total, limit: result.meta.limit, offset: result.meta.offset, members: result.members.map(function(member) { return Discourse.User.create(member); }) }); });` — no changed test verifies client consumption of the envelope or paged member reloads, so the UI can silently fail against the changed response.

[100][P2] spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:115 — `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42` — the automatic-group removal test invokes PUT while the new route is DELETE, so it can pass even if the production DELETE route is missing or miswired.
